notes: Initial full run exposed version-expectation and lock-cleanup issues; fixed and retested.
Build overlap produced API/query timeouts; API rechecks and final full suites pass.
Timescale install checks passed but DB drop raced an internal background session. Final harness retains generated DBs until labelled task-runtime cleanup.
Default PyPI DNS/download attempts failed; cold builds use verified HTTPS mirror and unchanged requirement hashes. Resolver failures before builds are retained.

First exact-image pipeline exposed an unnecessary source import on destination snapshot persistence. Conditional import and real-SQL regression fix it; failed run evidence is retained under v11-m5-pg-pipeline-import-failure.

The first TS image run's read-only test observer retained an HTTP keep-alive connection across READ restart. It now reconnects after the intentional restart; production worker transport retries are unchanged. Failed observer evidence retained.
